page.layout: One printed page (right side), title page. Title block at top, centred; a small ornament; author and description; edition line; scripture citation with quotation; woodcut emblem of a bear in a cartouche; imprint below the woodcut; date line at the foot. The left side shows only a page edge and faint show-through.

main_text.l: rige, sacrarum literarum Professore in Schola
Editio secunda, quam emendatiorem magnáque accefsione locupleta-
tam & illustratam reperiet lector. Quid præterea ha-
Annon MEMINISTIS me, cùm adhuc essem apud vos, hæc dixisse vobis? Nunc
verò quid obstet NOSTIS, vt is suo tempore retegatur, &c.
Excudebat Ioannes le Preux, Illustrissimorum Dominorum

page.notes: Woodcut: a bear within a decorative cartouche, flanked by putti and foliage, placed between the scripture quotation and the imprint. The small ornament below the title is a decorative fleuron. Printed date CIↃ IↃ LXXXIIII reads MDLXXXIIII. Some letters in the title lines are slightly worn but legible. Faint show-through from the reverse of the leaf appears to the right and left of the text and was omitted.
